name: Wide Button Module
title: Wide Button Module
subtitle: Kerbal Controller Mk1 · Main enclosure
revisions: Board V2.1: PCA9306 VREF2/EN pull-up, U19 pin 7 freed

rows.label: Microcontroller (U15 ATtiny816), programming supply OR (D2), INT_BUS divider (R29, R30)
Panel inputs U16, U17 (B16–B23), pull-downs RN1, RN2
Shift registers U18–U20 (U19 inputs E–H grounded, pin 7 open)
Twelve button channels SW1–SW12, LED data chain from NEOPIX_CMD through R32 (one channel on sheet 4)
I²C level converter (U1$CBB15 PCA9306, R3$CBB15 200 kΩ on VREF2/EN)
Button channel, shown for SW1 (U3, R5, R6, C5). Channel n (SWn) uses U(n+2), R(2n+3), R(2n+4), C(n+4)

stackup_note: JLCPCB JLC04161H-7628: dielectric materials and thicknesses as that stackup. Finished thickness 1.6 mm ±10 %.

layers.name: Top Layer
notes: Switch side: only the twelve PB26 switches mount here.

layers.name: Bottom Layer
notes: Component side: all SMT parts, the slot connector P1, the terminals CN1 / CN2 and the programming header H1.

fab_notes: 1. Material: FR-4, 1.6 mm, 4 layers, JLCPCB JLC04161H-7628 stackup (sheet 2 table).
2. Copper: 1 oz outer, 0.5 oz inner. Surface finish: lead-free HASL.
3. Solder mask green, silkscreen white, both sides. Vias tented.
4. Fabricate to IPC-6012 Class 2. Electrical test 100 %.
5. Dimensions in mm. Tolerances unless noted: outline ±0.2, finished holes ±0.08.
6. Fabricate from the Gerber and drill files of the same revision as this drawing.
7. Minimum trace width 0.20 mm. Smallest hole Ø0.30 (vias) on Ø0.61 pads: 0.15 mm annular ring.
8. The 6 plated mounting holes are not connected to any net; keep them isolated on all layers.
9. No controlled impedance, slots, castellations, edge plating or gold fingers.
bom_notes: 1. INSTALLED BY: JLCPCB = fitted by the JLCPCB assemblers (SMT and through-hole) before delivery; After delivery = fitted by the builder.
2. PROCESS gives the assembly process and the side the part is on.
3. The PB26 switches SW1–SW12 are self-sourced (no LCSC number) and soldered after delivery; see KC-01-1810 item 2.
4. Designators ending $CBB15 belong to the I²C level converter block (schematic sheet 3); R3$CBB15 is a different part from R3.
5. U16 and U17 are the panel input terminal blocks.
6. Substitutes need the approval of the design authority.

SW1.desc: Push-button switch, 26 × 15 mm, SPDT momentary, RGB LED

place_notes: 1. The switches SW1–SW12 are on the top side; every other part is on the bottom side. Each side is shown in two overlapping parts, top half and bottom half.
2. The bottom view is drawn as seen holding the board bottom side up (flipped left to right), so the datum is at the top right.
3. Red dot = pin 1 of every part with more than two pins and the cathode (pin 1) of D1. These match the silkscreen marks.
4. U16 and U17 are the panel input terminals (B16–B23). The level converter parts carry EasyEDA block designators (U1$CBB15, R1$CBB15 to R3$CBB15, C1$CBB15, C2$CBB15).
5. Part centres, rotations and part numbers are in the placement table (last sheets), measured from the datum (top view).
